candidates.change_summary: Replace recipient transfer with sending funds to msg.sender instead of provided _recipient, changing who receives withdrawn balance.
Require that the caller is NOT the owner (negate the ownership check), allowing only non-owners to withdraw and changing observable behavior.
Delete the require check so anyone can call withdrawAll and change who can trigger the withdrawal.
Replace transfer with sending zero value (no transfer), leaving the contract balance intact and changing post-call observable balance-related behavior.

Swap order: zero the contract balance (by sending to recipient) before require, so require can revert after transfer in original order; here require is after transfer to change behavior and potentially prevent transfer if reverted — move require below transfer.
